findings.quote: Artificial intelligence should complement and enhance human capabilities rather than diminish the indispensable role of people in shaping their own development.
findings.rationale: Welcomes AI applications in agriculture, health, education, climate resilience, finance and public services while insisting on human-centered development.

findings.quote: Malawi, therefore, calls upon the United Nations to continue promoting an inclusive, ethical, and development-oriented global framework for AI governance.
findings.rationale: Calls for UN-led governance protecting dignity and jobs, building capacity and equitable access, while warning of automation and compute, data, infrastructure, skills and financing divides.
